name: @zhenre/request
description: @zhenre request — axios-shaped fetch client: defaults, interceptors, timeout via AbortController, params serialization, typed RequestError. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/request.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/request.min.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
